name: 9:30 Bell Underdog, four coins
description: us-hours-vol v2 unchanged, pooled over ETH, BTC, XRP and DOGE: in the 15-minute window that starts at the 9:30 ET US stock market open, buy the currently losing side, because Kalshi prices it off calm pre-open vol and under-expects the opening-bell jump. Pooling four coins is the only way to get a sample big enough to settle it (~400 windows).
hypothesis: As us-hours-vol: Kalshi's implied vol in the 9:30 ET window is ~0.15-0.3 log too low (ETH/BTC 0.3; XRP -0.13, DOGE -0.17 in research/iv_gap.py), so the 10-45c underdog is cheap. Independent runs on ETH+BTC (+4.3c, CI -1.5..+10.5) and XRP+DOGE (bell-alts +4.2c, CI -3.5..+12.5) point the same way but each is sample-limited. Rule fixed (v2, max_spread 60). Wrong if pooled full CI not above 0, <60% months positive, or lockbox loses. Caveat: pooling after two inconclusive looks; the pool is not independent of them, so a pass is weaker evidence than a fresh one.
next: Full 1/3 inconclusive (+5.11c, CI -0.34..+10.42, 348 mkts, 5/6 months, fading: Jul +4.1, Aug +0.8). Not promising so no lockbox. Two full tests left; only rerun for a reason stated from development data.
